test_demo_notebook: test the habitat-lab demo notebook by running pytest with nbval-lax on notebooks/habitat-lab-demo.ipynb
get_config_pointnav: create a habitat config object by calling habitat.get_config with the pointnav_mp3d.yaml config file path
defrost_config: defrost a habitat config object so that its attributes like DATASET.SPLIT can be modified at runtime
check_config_paths_exist: check if the Matterport3D PointNav dataset and scene paths exist using PointNavDatasetV1.check_config_paths_exist
force_gc_collect: force a garbage collection run with gc.collect to clean up after notebook execution and avoid double context crashes
